description: This file defines the IsolatedClientLoader class and companion object, which manage loading specific versions of Hive in an isolated classloader environment for Spark SQL Hive integration. It includes logic for downloading Hive and Hadoop dependencies, creating classloaders, and instantiating Hive clients with version-specific configurations.

classes.name: IsolatedClientLoader
classes.description: Manages loading Hive dependencies in an isolated classloader environment, creating Hive clients, and handling class sharing rules.

methods.name: forVersion
methods.description: Creates an IsolatedClientLoader for a specific Hive and Hadoop version, downloading dependencies if necessary.

methods.name: hiveVersion
methods.description: Maps a version string to a HiveVersion enum based on major, minor, patch.

methods.name: supportsHadoopShadedClient
methods.description: Determines if a Hadoop version supports shaded Hadoop client dependencies.

methods.name: downloadVersion
methods.description: Downloads Hive and Hadoop dependencies from Maven repositories for a specific version.
